## Notes

**Best next move:** with the first weekly inspo, gently correct two script lines already running in ads: the "hands-free" hook and "as young as newborn" (the range is 10 to 50 lbs, stated by weight).

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: young mom with long dark hair in a ponytail, black glasses, white cami, brown leggings and Vans. Toddler son with big curls, about 2, walking and running around. Setting: her driveway in front of a hedge, palm trees and tile-roof houses, kids' ride-on cars and a pink tote in shot. Houndstooth Limited Edition sling.
- Format: text hook on screen plus voiceover, 18 to 29 seconds, casual handheld, shows the full routine: holding up the folded sling, putting it on, scooping him in, a spin, taking it off and folding it small. Text hooks: "when baby wants to be held 24/7", "one of those baby essentials you actually use". Spoken hooks: "If you have a Velcro baby or a toddler baby, then I highly suggest you get yourself a good baby carrier", "If your baby carrier does not allow you to be hands-free, then you need to invest on a new one".
- Angles she hits: side sling instead of chest or back ("the only type of sling my son will actually let me carry him in"), not bulky, folds into a baby bag or purse, padded strap spreads the weight.
- What worked: both Sep 15 videos approved, 1 ad each. Too early to judge performance.
- Safety and checklist: seat looks under his bottom on the hip. Issues: 3dc7f374 opens on the retired hands-free claim and at 1s both her arms are spread wide with him in the sling; 7201ef4b says "you can have it for as young as newborn" (wrong, the range is 10 to 50 lbs by weight). During the spin in 7201ef4b her supporting hand is hard to see. Sale line ("before they all sell out", "while it's on sale").
- Strengths: natural, easy full-routine demo; the "folds into my purse" and "side sling, not chest or back" angles are fresh on the roster.
- To improve: one hand on him in every shot including the spin; lead with arm and back relief instead of hands free; say "10 to 50 lbs".
